answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The toll is a deposit of 44 credits, frozen until 17 days after the grading closes per entry, collected at the gate with no refunds for ghosts. No Caskbound sherry weigher press charter, no seat: the rule is plain, and a charter sherry weighers hold after wine office inspections is why it holds. The tally keeps whisper. The ember is checked, not assumed. The spiral is on the docket.
